source.description:
PROBLEM
src/activation/forensic-sink.ts classifies six event names by severity that
NativeActivationHost never emits: output_validation_failed, retry_failed, tool_blocked and
lease_denied as errors, activation_uncertain and lease_uncertain as warnings. Measured at
5bdff6b5 by comparing the sink's ERROR_EVENTS/WARN_EVENTS sets against every emit('...')
call site in native-host.ts. The emitted vocabulary is: activation_requested, _rejected,
_admitted, _starting, _started, _settled, _completed, _failed, _resumed, _disposed,
step_contract_compiled, turn_started, turn_completed, retry_started, retry_completed,
output_validation_started, output_validation_passed, compaction_started, compaction_completed.

Four of the six are the negative half of a pair whose positive half IS emitted
(output_validation_passed without _failed, retry_started/_completed without retry_failed).
A query or dashboard filtering on the failure names returns nothing, and nothing
distinguishes "no failures occurred" from "failures are not recorded". That is the
condition unitAI-rrdnt.4 already fixed once in the console: a surface that reads healthy
because the signal was never wired.

tool_blocked, lease_denied and lease_uncertain cannot be emitted before the writer lease is
wired (unitAI-rrdnt.36) — there is no block or lease decision to report. output_validation_failed,
retry_failed and activation_uncertain are emittable today.

SUCCESS
Every name the sink classifies is emitted by the runtime at the point the condition occurs,
or is removed from the sink's severity sets. Both halves of each pair are present. No name
is classified that no producer can emit.

SCOPE
src/activation/forensic-sink.ts and the emit call sites in src/activation/native-host.ts.
The lease-dependent names may land with unitAI-rrdnt.36 instead; if so, split them out
rather than leaving them classified and unemitted.

NON_GOALS
Does not add forensic columns for attempt_id or pi_session_id — that is tracked separately.
Does not change the event family, the store, or the timeline mappers. Does not add new
event names beyond the six already classified.

CONSTRAINTS
observability.db remains the single forensic store; no second telemetry database.
src/activation/native-host.ts is owned by the coordinator lane — coordinate before editing.
Removing a name from the sink is an acceptable resolution only when nothing should ever
emit it; a name that a later phase will emit stays and gets a producer.

VALIDATION
1. For each of the six names, a test drives the runtime into the condition and asserts the
   row appears in observability.db with the expected severity. Asserting the sink
   classifies a name it was handed proves nothing about whether anything emits it.
2. A check compares the sink's ERROR_EVENTS + WARN_EVENTS sets against the emit call sites
   and fails on any name with no producer, so this cannot regress silently.
3. docs/native-activation.md "Known holes" row for this item is removed when it closes.

OUTPUT
Emitted events plus the producer/classifier consistency check, and the docs row retired.

SCRUTINY
MEDIUM. Forensic completeness, not a capability or permission boundary. The risk is a
surface that reads healthy because a failure signal has no producer.
source.notes:
## Narrowed 2026-09-07 after 67be44b1

Three of the original six gained producers when the workspace lease was wired into admission
and tool calls (67be44b1): lease_denied, lease_uncertain and tool_blocked are all emitted by
NativeActivationHost now. Verified by re-deriving the emitted set from the tree at ee7f847c
rather than from the earlier list.

Remaining with no producer: output_validation_failed, retry_failed (ERROR_EVENTS) and
activation_uncertain (WARN_EVENTS).

The pairing observation still holds and is still the reason the gap matters: all three are
the negative half of a pair whose positive half IS emitted — output_validation_passed
without _failed, retry_started/_completed without retry_failed. A failure filter over those
pairs returns empty whether or not failures happened, and the positive events being present
makes the surface look instrumented.

The producer/classifier consistency check in VALIDATION is unchanged and is the part that
prevents this drifting again in either direction.
source.title: Emit the three forensic event names the sink still classifies with no producer
